login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Enter your email address: we will send you a link that signs you in. No password needed.
login.sentBody: If an account matches {email}, a sign-in link is on its way. The link is valid for 15 minutes.
login.error: The link could not be sent. Please try again.

activate.title: Activate your purchase
activate.intro: Enter your Etsy order number and the email address used for the purchase.
activate.consentLabel: I accept the terms of sale and the privacy policy.

confirmation.title: Request received
confirmation.body: We will check your order and get back to you within 24 hours. Once approved, you will receive a sign-in link by email — there is nothing else to do for now.

errors.orderId: Enter your Etsy order number: 8 to 12 digits, no spaces.
errors.consent: You must accept the terms of sale and the privacy policy to continue.
errors.duplicatePending: A request for this order and this theme is already being reviewed. No need to submit it again — we will email you within 24 hours.
errors.duplicateApproved: This order has already been activated for this theme. Check your inbox for your sign-in link, or sign in if you already have an account.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts from this connection. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.

magicLinkEmail.subject: Your sign-in link
magicLinkEmail.heading: Your sign-in link
magicLinkEmail.body: Click the link below to sign in. It expires in 15 minutes.
magicLinkEmail.ignore: If you did not request this email, you can safely ignore it.
